title: House of Representatives of Australia
source: First preferences by division: Australian Electoral Commission, 2025 federal election (via the aec-2025-narrative dataset on GitHub). Compass positions: estimates on the Chapel Hill Expert Survey scales, which don't cover Australia. Preference flows: estimates.
notes: Preferential voting is STV with one seat per division. Country Liberal votes count as Liberal. Independents are one group: in each division it takes the strongest independent; the other independents and all minor parties are 'Other candidates'. Nobody stops ranking (voting is compulsory and preferential).
